citation: Lauc G, et al. Croat Med J 2026;67:226
protocol: 72-h water-only fast; blood in the morning before (T0), at end of the fast (T1, 72 h) and 11 days later (T2); fasting glucose, insulin, cortisol
population: 5 healthy volunteers (4 M, 1 F), aged 40-65, White, no acute or chronic disease
note: Tiny n=5 and medians with min-max, not means; T1 is end of fast, no intermediate hours.
